project.name: Paper Sky — pilot
project.stylePrompt: 2D anime, late-2000s TV anime look, clean line art, cel shading with soft gradients, warm painterly backgrounds, expressive eyes, subtle film grain, cinematic 16:9 composition.
project.suffixPrompt: No subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no on-screen text, no extra characters.

assets.name: Aki Tanaka
assets.description: 17-year-old girl, slim, shoulder-length black hair with a small red hair clip on the left, amber eyes, navy school blazer over a white shirt with a red ribbon tie, grey pleated skirt.
assets.notes: Quiet, observant, dry humor. Voice: low, unhurried.

assets.name: Ren Sato
assets.description: 17-year-old boy, tall and lanky, messy ash-brown hair, green eyes, same navy blazer worn open over an untucked white shirt, loosened tie, headphones around his neck.

assets.name: School Rooftop
assets.description: Flat concrete school rooftop at golden hour, chain-link fence along the edge, water tank, distant city skyline and a long orange sky.

scenes.title: 1 — Rooftop, after school
scenes.description: Aki has been waiting. Ren is late again.

shots.title: 1A establishing
shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of @rooftop. @aki stands alone at the fence with her back to camera, hair moving in the wind. Static tripod shot, only hair, skirt and clouds move. Ambient: distant traffic, wind.

shots.title: 1B Ren arrives
shots.prompt: Medium shot. The rooftop door bursts open and @ren stumbles through, out of breath, one hand raised in apology. Handheld feel, slight push-in. He says, panting: 'Sorry— club ran long.'

shots.title: 1C Aki turns
shots.prompt: Close-up on @aki. She turns her head slowly toward camera, unimpressed, then the corner of her mouth lifts. Shallow depth of field, rim light from the sunset. She says flatly: 'It's been twenty minutes.'

shots.title: 1D two-shot
shots.prompt: Two-shot from the side, @aki and @ren leaning on the fence looking at the skyline, city lights starting to turn on. Slow dolly right. @ren laughs, @aki hides a smile. Ambient wind, faint school chime.
